description: Test vector configurations to isolate which BFE coordinates drive FVDM extinction. Each entry replaces the standard empirical profile with a controlled vector.

all_ones._note: All coordinates = 1. Variable scoring: D + J + Df (constants cancel). Prediction: EXTINCT — J equally weighted with D.

imm_maxed._note: Immediate = all-ones, future = zeros. Variable scoring: D only (I, C, P, E constant per agent). Prediction: SURVIVE — pure greedy equivalent.

fut_maxed._note: Future = all-ones, immediate = zeros. Variable scoring: J + Df. Prediction: EXTINCT — J maximised, agents crowd wealthy-neighbour areas.

extent_maxed._note: Only E coordinate non-zero. E = 1/|V| is constant across all cells for one agent → random tiebreaking. Prediction: random walk, ~50% survival.

d_only._note: Pure D scorer. Equivalent to greedy argmax(sugar+spice). Prediction: SURVIVE — should match baseline.

j_only._note: Pure J scorer. Agent always moves to cell adjacent to wealthiest neighbours. Prediction: EXTINCT — follows crowds into depleted areas.

d_and_j_equal._note: D and J equally weighted. Prediction: BORDERLINE — J half as strong as D, may starve in dense environments.

egoist._note: Empirical egoist profile (control — should replicate extinction seen before).
